description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class 'TimeConfigPeriodAPI' within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods for retrieving and updating the timesheet period configuration, including handling validation rules, service instantiation, and API documentation annotations. The file serves as part of the Time module's API layer, specifically for managing time configuration periods.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing time sheet period configurations, including retrieving current settings and updating the start day of the period.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current time sheet period configuration, returning default or existing start day.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, excluding certain parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the time sheet period start day and enables related menu modules.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'update' endpoint; checks if period is already defined.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a 'Not Implemented' exception; deletion is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a 'Not Implemented' exception; no validation for delete.

methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the TimesheetPeriodService instance.
